description: This file defines the Note class which extends a File class and manages customer note records, including file handling, deletion, attachment content retrieval, and related data processing within the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a customer note, extending File to handle attachments and related operations in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: safeAttachmentName
methods.description: Sanitizes the filename by appending .txt if the extension is in the badext list.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Overrides parent method to delete associated files based on system settings when a note is marked as deleted.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes the attachment file from the filesystem and clears related fields.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the note's name as its summary text.

methods.name: getAttachmentContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the attachment file if it exists.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query for exporting notes with related contact and user info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Placeholder to fill in additional list view fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fetches related contact info and email address for detailed view.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list views, including file URLs and contact info.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Checks ACL permissions for list view display elements.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates the interfaces implemented by the bean ('ACL' and 'File').
